title: Wild joins
hook: **Wild joins** are demons that enter the roster from expedition outcomes — intake that is not the altar.

blindSpots.meaning: A specimen that arrives from an expedition result, not from a soul pull.
Any path that adds a demon. Altar, wild join, and (later) capture are different intakes.
Idle squad mission — dispatch, wait, collect. Detail: [expeditions](expeditions).
Soul gacha pulls. Wild joins prove gacha is not the only path.

alsoTrue: After a wild join lands, treat it like any [specimen](specimens) — bind, fuse, or field as usual.
Capture on the lawn/delve is a different WIP intake — see [capture](capture).

sections.title: What it is
paras: Expeditions can return more than materials and souls.
A wild join is a full specimen appearing in Creatures when the outcome says so.

sections.title: How you use it
steps: Dispatch an expedition with a squad.
If a wild join is in the report, open Creatures and meet the new specimen.
diagram: dispatch expedition  ->  wait  ->  collect  ->  wild join on roster

sections.title: Why it exists
paras: If only the altar grew the roster, idle play would never surprise you with a demon.
Wild joins keep expeditions on the summon-and-fusion spine.

doSteps: Send a squad and collect a return.
If no wild join this time, still read the report — joins are an outcome, not a guarantee every run.
doNote: Stop when altar ≠ only intake. WIP hunt path: [capture](capture).

mixUps.q: Did I get charged souls for a wild join?
mixUps.a: No. That is the point of a non-altar intake.

mixUps.q: Is every expedition return a new demon?
mixUps.a: No. Materials and souls are common; wild joins are one possible outcome.
No. Capture is WIP pressure-and-catch in a run.

mixUps.q: Can a wild join fuse later?
mixUps.a: Yes. It is a normal specimen once it lands.
